sections.title: találkozik + -val/-vel
sections.content: találkozik ("to meet") always pairs with -val/-vel for the person you meet — the same pattern kijön valakivel already taught you. Meeting is mutual, so there's no direct object at all: találkozik only ever takes the indefinite personal endings, whatever tense it's in. Találkoztam Károllyal. is "I met (with) Károly", never *találkoztam Károlyt.

items.spanish: Tegnap véletlenül találkoztam Tamással a piacon.
items.english: Yesterday I ran into Tamás by chance at the market.

items.spanish: Anna régen találkozott Gáborral, még Petra előtt.
items.english: Anna met Gábor a long time ago, even before Petra.

sections.content: kivel ("with whom") is just ki + -vel, built exactly like vele ("with him/her/it") — once you know one -vel pronoun, you know the shape of all of them.
